title: Amid Dexter Lawrence-Giants uncertainty, John Harbaugh says 'everybody's tradable'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Amid Dexter Lawrence-Giants uncertainty, John Harbaugh says 'everybody's tradable'
sources.description: Harbaugh did not directly say the Giants would trade Lawrence. But when asked about Kayvon Thibodeaux's trade value, Harbaugh gave a surprising response that could influence Lawrence's future as well.
